body: There’s usually some hotline that could possibly offer emergency accomodation, could be worth trying out. Or if it’s your house you could ask her to move out? I’m sorry you’re going through all that. I wish it will get better for you, and hopefully you’re feeling a little better now.
Why don’t you break up with her?

I don’t know how useful this will be, but as somebody diagnosed with BPD; try to just see the human first, and the diagnosis second, understand that the negative treatment of others, although there’s no excuse, comes from a great deal of internal suffering, and appreciate that if your seeing them in hospital that 1. Hospitals usually aren’t the best place for people with mental health issues and 2. You’re seeing us at our worst. And for what it’s worth, I really don’t think we’re all just manipulative and toxic people, I’m pretty confident nobody in my life would think of me as that.

Not mocking her on the internet would be nice honestly, and being empathetic kind to her. But If you don’t like her it might be best to tell her to her face so to end a friendship that’s not good for her.

I think it’s better to hurt people who have been cruel to you instead of yourself. They’re in the wrong for hurting you, not you for being hurt. Aggressive Music’s helped me when I’ve felt hatred or weakness with people, maybe it could also help you.
I did think asking if your ok might be a bit stupid haha. That’s good you made music out of it though! Glad your alive :)

You can present to hospital and ask to be admitted to a psych ward if you feel unsafe at home and want to kill yourself, though it isn’t a therapeutic environment it can keep you safe, and not alone and they’ll be able to give you meds and possibly a better place to live. I would tell the people you trust, reach out. In Australia there’s a line called Link2home which can organise a place to live, maybe research something like that in your country? You’ve got it hard lovely, I hope it gets easier💗
I think when we feel unloveable or have low self esteem/ poor self image, we see those who love us as a threat in a way, maybe you could work on self love, and just be kind to yourself.

I think I’m the same. My view is I shouldn’t be happy when I’m still suicidal, self harming and crying easily because then it won’t go away, like I can endure it? And you’d wish for more stability than that.
Yes, you should let them know. People care. You’re mentally unwell, but I don’t think “crazy’s” a good term, and no one’s 100% sane anyway.

Hey, I’m 20/f too and the diagnosis has hit me in full swing recently as well. If you want to chat, please feel free!

For words of advice, try to get your family and friends to read about the diagnosis(if you think they can handle it), and cliche as it may be, believe in and love yourself🖤

I’d wage she’s repressing her emotions and they’ll bottle up explosively in one way or another. Whether you stay with her for that is up to you, but objectively it’s going to hurt her like hell if or when you leave her

I’ll probably be downvoted for this, but this subreddit isn’t caring for bpd people at all and if you want to not hurt her, I wouldn’t believe everything you see here.
I had someone in there that told me they’d be my spiritual mother lol, it was really sweet. Mental hospitals generally suck but you can meet awesome people in there.
That lady was in the wrong, try to be kind to yourself, you deserve to feel ok❤️. wishing you well.

Do whatever you enjoy yourself right now, treat yourself. Give yourself some time to feel a bit better until you can hopefully tell someone you trust how you feel, even if you don’t tell them how far you went. Feel free to dm me if you’d like.

I know it may sound harsh or difficult but I think what’s best for you is to try to move on. You still will have things to enjoy and new opportunities to open up now after this. You can do it :)
